study: Joint nonlinear searches beyond fixed AES stage interfaces

tail_coset_search.scope: Left in each single-tail basis coset plus arbitrary pre-tail affine form; right arbitrary retained affine form. Multi-tail left cosets remain open.
tail_coset_search.audit_scope: Independent source and matrix reconstruction, small brute-force controls, boundary probes and sampled AES steps; not a full independent exhaustive replay.

free_cone_search.scope: Both operands are arbitrary affine forms of retained signals and previous replacements; final decoder free. Only 256 reachable rows, no fixed removed functions or depth cap.

canonical_cone_search.symmetry: Operand constant removal and echelon basis of coefficient planes, with free downstream affine correction.

local_selector_search.scope: Bounded walk with random reservoir selection among distinct unvisited output-deficit-one spans, exhausting radius-two selector changes at each visited circuit. Not all representations or semantic states were covered.

prior_art.fact: SAT synthesis of multiplicative complexity, symmetry reduction and counterexample-guided solving are established methods.
Topology-family exact synthesis is established prior art.

conclusion: No smaller correct AES circuit found. Exact negatives apply only to named finite neighborhoods; joint-cone solver timeouts establish no infeasibility or novelty.
